_comment: Deterministic repository health ratchets. Each value is a CEILING: the build fails if the current value exceeds it. Lowering a value is a deliberate act that makes the end state strictly better. Timing budgets live in doc/BUILD_HEALTH.md and are measured on a schedule, not per-PR.

notes.todoFixmeMarkers: Ceiling only. Do not raise to accommodate new work; record intentional debt in doc/REBUILD_STATUS.md instead.
notes.releaseApkMibPerAbi: Track release, not debug. Debug is ~126 MiB because it is unminified and is not a shipped-payload signal.
notes.mainSourceFiles: Grows legitimately during the reconstruction. Tracked for visibility, not gated, until the legacy deletion task defines a target.
